description.p: Aegis Vault is a free, open-source offline password manager that keeps your logins, credit cards, subscriptions, and secure notes encrypted strictly on your computer.

ul.li: Two-layer local security with 600,000-round PBKDF2 and AES-256-GCM
Crash-safe atomic saves with automatic .bak recovery
Automatic 2-week encrypted disk backups in Documents/Aegis-Backups
One-click import from Chrome, Bitwarden, and LastPass

description.p: Switched to 100% local two-layer encrypted vault architecture with atomic saves and 2-week encrypted disk backups.
